purpose: Learn whether OFFLINE-01 fails on Linux WebKit, the environment GitHub CI uses, before relying on CI going green after formatting.

environment.image: happy-cookie-offline-probe:497c6b7, built from the unchanged Dockerfile.visual

webkitFailures: page.reload: WebKit encountered an internal error (bazaar-offline.spec.ts:103), twice
Test timeout of 30000ms at the Cash button click (bazaar-offline.spec.ts:80), once

upstream.label: v1.64
upstream.note: Reproduced on macOS on tip-of-tree per the issue thread; latest published release is v1.63.0 (2026-09-04).

conclusion: OFFLINE-01 fails on Linux WebKit as well as Windows WebKit under Playwright 1.63.0. The CI Browser flows job and the owner-trial release job that depends on it will fail after format:check passes. No test, application, service-worker or queue source was changed.
limits: Local container, not a GitHub-hosted runner.
One timeout failure differs from the known reload error and was not investigated.
Does not establish actual Safari or installed-PWA behaviour; the physical-phone rehearsal remains separate.
